attributes.body_ja:
助動詞（じょどうし）の「れる」や「られる」が、名詞（めいし）「まま」（意味（いみ）：〜の状態（じょうたい）で）と格助詞（かくじょし）「に」に結（むす）びつくと、自分（じぶん）と意思（いし）とは関係（かんけい）なく、ただ「言（い）われた通（とお）りに」または「命令（めいれい）された通（とお）りに」何（なに）かを行（おこな）うことを表（あらわ）します。そのため、「れる」と「られる」は、意思伝達（いしでんたつ）に関（かん）する動詞（どうし）と一緒（いっしょ）によく使（つか）われます。

これらは受身（うけみ）の表現（ひょうげん）なので、文字通（もじどお）りには「(A) されている状態（じょうたい）で、(B) をする」といった意味（いみ）に近（ちか）いです。「ままに」の後（あと）には (B) が続（つづ）き、(A) されている中（なか）でどのような行動（こうどう）が取（と）られたのかが述（の）べられます。

「られる」と「ままに」の間（あいだ）に接続助詞（せつぞくじょし）の「が」が入（はい）ることもありますが、現代（げんだい）では省（はぶ）かれることも多（おお）いです。「が」にはもともと逆接（ぎゃくせつ）の意味（いみ）がありますが、この場合（ばあい）は、(A) に対（たい）して抵抗（ていこう）せずにそのまま (B) を行（おこな）うことを強調（きょうちょう）するために使（つか）われています。

注意点（ちゅういてん）

この表現（ひょうげん）では、基本的（きほんてき）に「られる」が過去形（かこけい）になることはありません。
attributes.body:
When paired with まま, a noun meaning 'in the state of', and the case marking particle に, the auxiliary verbs れる and られる indicate something being done 'as one is told', or 'as ordered'. Because of this, れる and られる will almost always be paired with verbs that indicate some kind of communication.

As these structures are in the passive, the literal translation is close to 'to do (B) in the state that (A) was done to me'. The (B) part will come directly after ままに and simply states how someone is going to react in compliance with (A).

The conjunction particle が may appear between られる and ままに, but this is not common in modern Japanese. Although it does carry the meaning of 'but', the focus is more on expressing that the (A) is not being resisted or argued with when doing (B).

Caution

In this grammar pattern, られる will never appear in the past-tense form.

Both convey doing something in accordance with something else, but differ in nuance. れる・られる + ままに implies doing something exactly as told or forced, with little choice, as in 指示されるがままにやった (I did it exactly as instructed). に沿って simply means in line with a tangible or figurative standard, as in 点線に沿って (along the dotted line) or スケジュールに沿って (in line with the schedule), without implying lack of control.

first_relatable.title: れる・られる + ままに
first_relatable.meaning: Do as (one is told or ordered…), In accordance with, In compliance with, Just like

second_relatable.title: に沿って
second_relatable.meaning: Along, In accordance with, In line with

attributes.body: Both patterns use まま, but れる・られる + ままに expresses acting in line with orders or circumstances, e.g. 言われるがままにする ('Do exactly as told'). In contrast, standalone まま(に) is used in a wider range of contexts to express an unchanged state, e.g. 窓が開けたままになっている ('The window is still open'). The compound implies passivity; the base form, a persistent state.

first_relatable.title: れる・られる + ままに
first_relatable.meaning: Do as (one is told or ordered…), In accordance with, In compliance with, Just like

second_relatable.title: まま(に)
second_relatable.meaning: As is, While remaining, Left in a state

attributes.body: Both convey the idea of doing something in precisely a certain way, but differ in nuance. れる・られる + ままに implies passivity or being compelled by external forces. For example, 言われるがままにやった ('I did as told'). とおり can be used similarly, as in 言われたとおりにやった ('I did it just as I was told'), but also appears in neutral contexts. For example, レシピのとおりに作った ('I made it exactly according to the recipe').

second_relatable.title: とおり
second_relatable.meaning: In that way, Exactly, Precisely, Just as

attributes.body: The passive form (Verb［れる・られる］) is used to show that an action was done to someone. For example, 言われた means 'was told'. When combined with ままに 'in that state', it can express following instructions exactly, e.g. 言われるままに買った ('I bought it just as I was told.').

first_relatable.title: れる・られる + ままに

second_relatable.title: Verb［れる・られる］
second_relatable.meaning: Was done to ~ by ~, Done without consent, Done to one's dismay

attributes.body: れる・られる + ままに implies doing something in accordance with external directions, often with little control, as in 指示されるがままに (exactly as instructed). にしたがって also means in accordance with, as in 規則に従って (in accordance with the regulations), but does not necessarily imply lack of volition.

first_relatable.title: れる・られる + ままに

second_relatable.title: にしたがって
second_relatable.meaning: As, Following, As then, According to, In accordance with

attributes.body: Both structures express doing something in a certain way. れる・られる + ままに is used when someone acts as they're told, e.g. 言われるがままに 'just as told'. ように can express acting of one's own accord, e.g. 間に合うように早めに出た ('I left early so I could make it on time.').
